_comment: THE canonical version-matrix construct catalogue (VERSION_TEST_MATRIX_DESIGN.md §10 #5). Each entry: a minimal program exercising ONE construct + its edition metadata. VersionMatrixTests computes the expected outcome per (construct × edition): compiles iff introducedIn <= V and (removedIn null or V < removedIn). The human-readable VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE.md and the in-code ConstructDialectStatus registry are renderings of THIS file — extend it here, never fork. 'vcr' cites the VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE row/section or the introducing standard where the doc has no row (it covers 2002→2023 deltas only). OPTIONAL 'status': 'pending' = catalogued (edition metadata frozen by the drift tests) but not yet implemented — the matrix SKIPS its compile assertions until the owning roadmap phase lands and flips it active (the one pending mechanism, shared with the corpus discovery manifests). Vendor-dialect constructs live in vendor-constructs.json (owner decision 2), never here.

constructs.description: Nucleus MOVE/DISPLAY — edition-invariant since COBOL-85
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. NUC.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W PIC X(5) VALUE "HI".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE "BYE" TO W.
    DISPLAY W.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: READ ... PREVIOUS (keyed sequential read in reverse), ISO §14.9.30 Format 1 — introduced 2002
constructs.vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard); rows 29/108 gate the after-OPEN behavior
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. RP.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrp" ORGANIZATION IS RELATIVE
        ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC RELATIVE KEY IS W-K.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 W-K PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O F.
    READ F PREVIOUS AT END DISPLAY "E".
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: EXIT METHOD statement - introduced 2002 (OO/UDF), REMOVED 2023 (Annex E; dual-obligation window: 0900 below 2002, 0902 at 2023). PENDING (rationale corrected per the W2 adversarial review, DEVLOG 595): the source COMPILES at 2002/2014 today only because the placement SR (the statement may appear only inside a method/function definition - cf. the 14.9.14.3 rule-7 pattern) is unimplemented, and the emitted stub is runtime-loud; a conforming positive source needs a METHOD-ID/FUNCTION-ID unit plus per-edition expectDiagnostic support (0900 at 85 vs 0902 at 2023). Reactivates with Phase 3/4c.

constructs.description: MOVE of an alphanumeric figurative constant (SPACE, QUOTE, HIGH-VALUE, LOW-VALUE, non-digit ALL literal) to a numeric or numeric-edited item - permitted through 2014 (pre-removal semantics per the legacy oracle, provisional per ratified decision 1; implemented on the StoreAsImage substrate), REMOVED by ISO 2023 (Annex E.2 item 1 bullet 1; 14.9.25.3 SR5) except the digit-only-ALL-to-integer case; QUOTE rides its own dual row move-quote-numeric-obsolete-2014 (obsolete 2014 first, Annex E.2 item 21 - the adversarial-review correction). Documented residues (DEVLOG 595): pre-removal image semantics cover elementary numeric-DISPLAY receivers - a Tier-A REDEFINES-class or BINARY/PACKED/COMP-5/float receiver stays a NARROW runtime-loud guard (legal-per-ISO-2014 shapes, no corpus hits); multi-char digit-only ALL rides this row at 2023 (the 2002 edge unproven in-repo, VCR 7.13). Gate: StatementBinder.MoveFigurative.cs (W2 track A, DEVLOG 593).
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. MVFIG.
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.

PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.

    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: MOVE of a digit-only ALL literal (or a digit symbolic-character) to an INTEGER numeric item - the sole surviving alphanumeric-figurative-to-numeric MOVE (14.9.25.3 SR5), valid at EVERY edition (the BoundAllLiteral runtime-loud latent bug fixed by AllDigitFill compile-time folding, 8.3.3.6.4 GR2 + 14.9.25.4 GR6d3b), obsolete-flagged 0903 at 2023 (SR5 NOTE; Annex F.2 item 2). Gate: StatementBinder.MoveFigurative.cs (W2 track A, DEVLOG 593).

constructs.description: The logical XOR / EXCLUSIVE-OR operator (ISO 8.8.4.9; precedence NOT > AND > XOR > OR) - a 2023 addition (Annex E.2 item 25 reserves both words; VCR rows 32/41 - the chair-adjudicated regating of the former '2002' mislabel). The operator is {is2023()}?-gated; below 2023 the W1.5 parse-layer mapping names the edition (0900) and both words are user-defined words.

01 WS-B PIC 9 VALUE 0.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    IF WS-A = 1 XOR WS-B = 1 DISPLAY "T" ELSE DISPLAY "F".
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: RERUN clause (I-O-CONTROL) - the '85 checkpoint hint (RERUN [ON file/implementor-name] EVERY {[END OF] REEL/UNIT OF f | n RECORDS [OF f] | n CLOCK-UNITS | condition-name}); no program-visible effect, parsed-and-ignored at 85 (a null rerun facility is conforming); deleted by ISO 2002 (absent from the whole 2023 text, 8.9 included).
constructs.vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.15; the W3 notInGrammar 85-acceptance batch (DEVLOG 599)
constructs.source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRR1.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F ASSIGN TO "vmrr" ORGANIZATION IS SEQUENTIAL.
I-O-CONTROL.
    RERUN ON F EVERY 10 RECORDS OF F.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F.
01 R PIC X(10).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT F.
    MOVE "CHECKPOINT" TO R.
    WRITE R.
    CLOSE F.
    STOP RUN.

constructs.description: USE FOR DEBUGGING declarative (the '85 debug facility) - deleted by ISO 2002 with the whole facility (DEBUG-* registers included). Accepted-inert at 85: without WITH DEBUGGING MODE the debugging section is compiled as if comment lines (the '85 rule); with it, compiled but never triggered (the object-time switch is permanently off). Companion of debugging-mode-removed-2002.
constructs.vcr: VCR Table 7 row 7.17; the W3 notInGrammar 85-acceptance batch (DEVLOG 599)

DBG-PARA.
    DISPLAY "NEVER-SEEN".
END DECLARATIVES.
MAIN SECTION.
M1.

    STOP RUN.

Companion of segment-limit-removed-2002.
